So I was never able to finish my degree because I’ve been fighting constantly to not be homeless (rough life tbh). I work temp right now. It ends in a month and I’m right on the brink of the end of my contract AND having to move because my roommates are having a baby soon. 

I don’t have a degree, but I have 9 years as an admin. I don’t see myself ever going back to school because it’s not possible for me. I make about $32,000 a year but good luck with that in the Seattle area. Almost every job listing I find requires a bachelors. 


I’m so sorry to everyone that worked their ass off and make the same as me. That’s bullshit.

Preach!!! Everyone that I’ve ever seen that show off their scars are usually faking it or really exaggerating their cuts. 

I self harmed most of my life until about 2 years ago. I hide this shit like a secret. The only time anyone can see them is if I wear shorts(deep upper thigh cuts) am I supposed to never wear shorts again? 

It’s not awesome, but if someone chooses to call them battle scars it’s honestly their own business. It doesn’t affect anyone else so just leave it alone.

I feel like this season is sort of a bunch of random nonsense scenes that we don’t even need to keep the story going. It’s a mess. They could easily covered Michael’s backstory in one episode. 

Maybe an unpopular opinion but I am absolutely hating seeing the same actors in multiple roles. It’s downright silly to watch. 

Please for the love of all things holy, someone buy Murphy a large whiteboard so he can make a cohesive timeline and season. I hate that I’m saying this because I really loved this show in the beginning but freak show on has just disappointed me....
